subject: Eval MAP: BeaconDX POC environment wiring and close plan
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alice Romero <alice@beacondx.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Eval MAP: BeaconDX POC environment wiring and close plan

Hi Alice and team,

Thanks again for the time earlier — following up with a concise MAP-focused checklist for the POC environment so we can finalize the close timeline. We want to make sure there are no blockers on the infra side (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, and VPC peering). Below is a proposed sprint with owners and acceptance criteria.

POC environment checklist (what we need from BeaconDX):
- Org & team access: create an org-level Read/Write service account for Redwood (email redwood-poc@beacondx.com) — owner: Security/Platform
- API keys: request generation and short TTL test key for staging (rotate after cutover)
- IP allowlist: provide egress IP CIDR for your firewall (we'll supply our edge IPs)
- VPC peering: confirm route-based peering or VPN tunnel preferences + a contact for network ops

Redwood deliverables:
- Provide exact edge IPs and peering manifest (network_diagram_v1.pdf attached)
- Share map_timeline_v2.xlsx with sprint dates and gating criteria (attached)

Proposed timeline:
- Day 0–2: Org & API key provisioning + allowlist
- Day 3: Peering setup and smoke test
- Day 4–5: Functional test with sample workload; acceptance signoff

Can you confirm owners for the first two items and whether your infra team prefers route-based peering vs. VPN? If you want, Vivek can join the network call tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks — I’ll loop Aditya on credit/finance approvals once we lock the schedule.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: network_diagram_v1.pdf (diagram, 1.2MB)
Attachment: map_timeline_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Alice Romero <alice@beacondx.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Infra Team <infra@beacondx.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval MAP: BeaconDX POC environment wiring and close plan

Hi Camila — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers from our side:

- Owners: I will own the org/service-account work (I own Platform Integrations). I’ve looped infra@beacondx for peering and firewall.
- API keys: We can generate a test key with a 7-day TTL. Do you require a specific scope?
- IP allowlist: We need the exact IPs you’ll originate from (public egress). If you can provide CIDRs we’ll put them on the firewall schedule.
- Peering: infra prefers route-based peering (we have an existing VGW setup). They asked whether Redwood supports route propagation and whether we need to add static routes.

If Vivek can join the call tomorrow at 2pm PT that works — infra suggested 2:30pm PT to give them time to pull network configs. I’ve attached a short internal note (no PII) they asked to share.

Thanks,
Alice Romero
Head of Platform Integrations
BeaconDX
---
Attachment: beacondx_infra_notes.txt (internal checklist, 3KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alice Romero <alice@beacondx.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval MAP: BeaconDX POC environment wiring and close plan

Thanks Alice — quick technical clarifications from the Redwood side:

- API key scope: We need token-level access for inference endpoints (generation + embeddings). Scoped keys are fine; a staging key with these scopes is preferred.
- Edge IPs: static egress: 52.211.18.32/28 and 52.211.19.0/28 (please add these to the allowlist for the testing window).
- VPC peering: we support route-based peering and accept propagated routes. For customers that prefer static routes, we can provide a small set of route prefixes.
- Peering ownership: Network handoff should be between Infra (beacondx) and Redwood Infra Ops (myself). For the handoff call, I’ll have the peering playbook and tests ready.

Acceptance tests we’ll run once peering and allowlist are in place:
1) 3x generation requests at 2 concurrent clients without errors
2) 50 embedding requests burst test (validate throughput)
3) Latency sample — 95th percentile under 350ms for the test model

I’ve pasted the quick smoke test commands below and will upload a close-playbook to the Drive link.

On Wed 2:30pm PT works for me. Camila — can you confirm meeting invite? Evelyn, can you own test reporting and signoff?

-Vivek
Infra & Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alice Romero <alice@beacondx.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2028 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval MAP: BeaconDX POC environment wiring and close plan

Perfect — thank you all for the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and owners:

- BeaconDX: Alice -> org/service account + request API key (7-day TTL, generation+embeddings scope)
- BeaconDX Infra: infra@beacondx.com -> add 52.211.18.32/28 and 52.211.19.0/28 to allowlist; set route-based peering with propagated routes
- Redwood: Vivek -> peering playbook + smoke tests; Evelyn -> test reporting and acceptance signoff
- Redwood: Camila -> schedule call, coordinate finance credit approval with Aditya

I’ve attached an updated MAP timeline (map_timeline_v2.xlsx) with dates for the sprint and a short owner matrix. Once infra confirms peering window we’ll aim to close the POC within 5 business days from peering completion.

Aditya — can you confirm whether we can apply the standard 14-day POC credit for BeaconDX (deal RDI-2391)? If yes, I’ll record that in the HubSpot milestone and proceed to finalize the MAP.

Meeting: Wed Jun 12 14:30 PT — invite sent.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
